specification.purpose: Defines the normative rules, constraints, and behavioral guarantees of the FFT AI Edition v1.2 runtime stack.

rules.statement: Every active session MUST declare an AA Mode at bootstrap. Default is AA2 unless overridden by operator profile.
3C conditions (C1 Coherence, C2 Clarity, C3 Continuity) MUST be evaluated at each regime transition and session boundary.
Harmonic lattice state MUST be maintained in session.state and updated on every RTT node transition.
Triad position (T,S,M) MUST be resolvable for every active field signal. Unresolvable triads MUST raise a structural paradox.
Substrate compatibility MUST be verified before any operator is dispatched. Incompatible substrates MUST be bridged or blocked.
Sessions SHOULD persist awareness state across regime transitions using the awareness overlay.
Alignment records SHOULD be written to session.alignments after every successful 3C pass.
Operators MAY escalate to AA3 autonomy mode when paradox density exceeds 0.40 and lattice stability falls below 0.60.
RTT12 harmonic resolution MUST collapse back to RTT1 with an updated coherence baseline. Skip-resolution is forbidden.
All file-level JSON MUST include spec_version, canon_id, edition, aa_mode, and last_refreshed fields.
